tagline: Organizations can now centrally configure coding agents: models, MCP servers, skills, a default harness and models, and Smart Routing.
what_it_does: Organizations can now centrally configure coding agents: models, MCP servers, skills, a default harness and models, and Smart Routing. Settings apply at agent launch, or roll out through mobile device management (MDM). Use a coding agent configuration to give your team a shared setup for agents, models, MCP servers, and skills.
